newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end lower in narrow trading.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end lower in narrow trading.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange futures ended lower in quiet, rangebound trading as the market stabilised following Tuesday's sharp losses due to speculative liquidation and local selling.
Analyst Bernard Savaiko of PaineWebber noted that the September to November spread widened sharply to six cents, though Hurricane Edouard was having little effect on the market.
"The market is watching the storm, but the probability is it will not move into the U.S. let alone into the orange growing areas," Savaiko said.
November FCOJ settled 0.50 cent lower at 114.30 cents, traded 114.80 to 113.70 cents. September went out 0.15 cent weaker at 120.35 cents.
